key_insight: Stochastic transport connects uncertainty modelling in geophysical flows with rigorous mathematical analysis, data-driven calibration and high-dimensional Bayesian inference.
engineering_relevance: This framework supports uncertainty quantification and forecasting for ocean and other geophysical fluid systems.
method: Establish well-posedness, regularity and approximation theory using stochastic variational principles, rough paths and fractional transport models.
Calibrate stochastic transport structures from observations and high-resolution simulations using reduced-order and generative models.
Develop Bayesian data assimilation through particle filters and machine learning uncertainty quantification.
evidence_signal: The abstract synthesizes theoretical and methodological developments and identifies observational and simulation data for calibration, but reports no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: Practical scalability and forecast improvements in high-dimensional applications require validation beyond the results described in the abstract.
paper_title: From Stochastic Transport Models to High-Dimensional Bayesian Inference
